summary: The study describes the use of atomic layer deposition (ALD) to fabricate Al2O3 embedded current-confinement structures in long-wavelength InAlGaAs VCSELs. The ALD process uses trimethyl aluminium (TMA) and H2O as precursors at a temperature range of 250–14 °C. The Al2O3 thin films provide mechanical stability and suppress leakage current, enabling high output power and direct modulation characteristics.
evidence: In this work, Al2O3 films were deposited at a temperature of 250/C14 C using trimethyl aluminium (TMA) and H2O as precursors.
